title: Filipino Yeast Bread
description: Soft, flavorful bread with a hint of yeast, perfect for snacking or serving with a meal.
instructions: 1. In a small bowl, combine yeast and warm water.
2. Add sugar and kare kare powder to the bowl. Stir until dissolved.
3. Let mixture sit for 5-10 minutes, or until frothy.
4. In a large mixing bowl, combine flour and salt.
5. Add yeast mixture to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
6. Knead dough for 5-10 minutes until smooth.
7. Place dough in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
9. Punch down dough and shape into a round loaf.
10. Place loaf on a baking sheet and brush with quietly oil.
11. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
